sprint: INSPECT-0 Source Register + Dutch Profile Design
product_boundary: This profile defines evidence that 4veco can expose to support school/provider inspection preparation. It is not a compliance certificate and does not replace school implementation evidence or competent-authority judgement.
exercise_first_boundary: Inspection standards may identify evidence categories and quality requirements, but they do not mint MTUs, target exercises, procedures, lesson goals, or student-facing content. Real CvTE tasks, correction models, reviewed target exercises, and built paragraph target exercises remain stronger curricular evidence.
evidence_strength_order: official CvTE exam questions and correction models
generated student-facing paragraph artifacts verified in 4veco-lessen
safe_claims: 4veco is designed to support Dutch inspection-relevant evidence.
4veco exposes evidence that helps schools demonstrate curriculum coherence, didactic quality, assessment alignment, student support, accessibility, and internal quality assurance.
4veco's Dutch evidence profile maps product evidence to inspection-relevant categories without claiming inspection approval.
forbidden_claims: 4veco is compliant with Dutch inspection standards.
4veco is approved by the Dutch Inspectorate of Education.
A 4veco book by itself satisfies a school's inspection obligations.
Inspection prose authorises new economics lesson units or target exercises.

categories.label: Curriculum offer
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP0 Basisvaardigheden where the offer concerns Dutch language, mathematics/arithmetic, and citizenship
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Coverage reports are not yet an inspection-specific evidence pack.
The model must distinguish planned coverage from generated, reviewed lesson evidence.
Foreign curriculum mappings are not authorised in this Dutch profile.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The school remains responsible for its full curriculum plan, scheduling, classroom implementation, and local policy choices.

categories.label: Basic skills
4veco_evidence_targets: citizenship and economic participation contexts where relevant
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: OP0 evidence is not yet exposed as a dedicated Dutch inspection profile.
Citizenship/economic participation evidence is likely contextual and should not be overstated.
Language-reasoning evidence needs careful distinction between Dutch-language skill and economics answer construction.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: 4veco can expose subject-material evidence; the school must show deliberate curriculum choices and classroom practice across all basic skills.

categories.label: Didactic quality
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP1 Aanbod where learning progression and provision are inspected
4veco_evidence_targets: student-visible route from Start to Check
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Rendered student-route proof is currently bounded and not broad product proof.
Some companion/check surfaces remain under controlled-scope review rather than scale-ready status.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The product can provide didactic materials; the school must show actual teacher practice, adaptation, and classroom interaction.

categories.label: Student development and support
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP2 Zicht op ontwikkeling en begeleiding
OP3 where support affects didactic action
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: 4veco must avoid diagnostic, mastery, automatic sequencing, or summative claims.
Short-check and exit-ticket surfaces are not complete across all paragraphs.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: Student monitoring, care plans, support decisions, and intervention records are school-owned evidence, not textbook evidence.

categories.label: Assessment and closure
dutch_inspection_anchor: OP1/OP3 where assessment alignment supports offer and didactic quality
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Official correction-model ingestion is not yet fully represented.
Exit-ticket target-equivalent proof remains controlled and incomplete across the first-three-paragraph product proof set.
Assessment evidence must remain local and non-summative unless later gates authorise broader claims.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: School summative assessment policy, PTA/transition decisions, and formal grading remain school responsibilities.

categories.label: Accessibility and inclusion
dutch_inspection_anchor: Cross-cutting evidence for student access, support, and didactic quality
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Accessibility evidence is currently review/proof-artifact based, not an inspection-specific profile.
Mobile/dark-mode proof can be route-specific and should not be generalised.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: The school remains responsible for individual accommodations, device access, and inclusive classroom implementation.

categories.label: Quality assurance
dutch_inspection_anchor: SKA quality assurance standards at governance level
Evidence supporting systematic school/product quality development
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Generated reports are diagnostic and not primary evidence.
Inspection evidence is not yet integrated into a report-only validator or teacher pack.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: School governance, self-evaluation, improvement planning, and inspection conversations remain school-owned.

categories.label: Improvement cycle
known_gaps_or_weaknesses: Inspection-specific improvement logs do not exist yet beyond INSPECT-0 setup logs.
Future evidence packs must separate product improvement from school improvement.
categories.school_implementation_boundary: A 4veco issue/review cycle can support but cannot replace the school's own quality cycle.

next_recommended_step: Human review of this v0 profile, then report-only schema design only if the profile is accepted.
